title: support/contractevents rejects CAP-67 three-topic SAC mint and clawback events, so consumers such as stellar-etl write no effect for them

target.versions_affected: v0.9.0 and main 376279e8 (support/contractevents); seen through stellar-etl 2b24ec89 (v2.8.34) and a046ba53 (release-v20261117 head); lower bound not established

severity_basis: Silent drop in a derived table: every mint by invoke_host_function in pubnet ledger 64558277 (34 of 34) has no account_credited or contract_credited effect in stellar-etl's effects export, while every classic-payment mint (101 of 101) has one; the token-transfer export records the same mints correctly. Not attacker-controlled. Cause from code reading: support/contractevents accepts only the four-topic (pre-CAP-67) mint and clawback layouts. The three-topic clawback takes the same path; not executed.

entries.expected: the mint recipient is credited (participant, balance change) for the operation
entries.observed: Executed at stellar-etl v2.8.34 (2b24ec89) through the replay harness: dropped · partial, no participant and no balance_changed for GB237VS5… KALE in transaction b35be42e…; the effects export has no row for the operation.

evidence.pre_fix: xcc replay with the stellar-etl adapter at 2b24ec89 on cap-0067/sac-mint-three-topics with --assert-known (evidence/stellar-etl/reproduce.sh): dropped · partial. In the effects export of ledger 64558277, 34 of 34 invoke_host_function SAC mints have no credited effect and 101 of 101 classic-payment mints have one. Same result at a046ba53 (go-stellar-sdk v0.9.0). Source: support/contractevents parseBalanceChangeEvent requires four topics, unchanged in v0.9.0.
evidence.expected_basis: CAP-67: a SAC mint event is ["mint", to, asset] with the amount as data (a clawback likewise ["clawback", from, asset]); the ledger credits the recipient (balance change in the operation's meta).

reproduction.method: Re-run at stellar-etl 2b24ec89 and a046ba53 (go-stellar-sdk v0.9.0): xcc replay with the stellar-etl adapter on cap-0067/sac-mint-three-topics reports dropped · partial; the effects tally of ledger 64558277 is unchanged (34 of 34 contract mints uncredited). Source read again in go-stellar-sdk v0.9.0.

queries: stellar/stellar-etl epic #448 members #449-#465 (#460 covers CAP-73 effects and muxed SAC destinations, not the three-topic mint)

approval.scope: Public issue on stellar/go-stellar-sdk (#6043): support/contractevents rejects CAP-67 three-topic SAC mint and clawback events; describes the stellar-etl effects impact.

history.note: Created from a replay of cap-0067/sac-mint-three-topics through the stellar-etl adapter and a tally of its effects export; no public upstream item found.

Still reproduces at stellar-etl a046ba53 (go-stellar-sdk v0.9.0, release branch release-v20261117). Retargeted to the root cause in go-stellar-sdk support/contractevents; stellar-etl's effects export is the affected consumer. Scope widened to clawback, which takes the same three-topic path.

Filed by the maintainers of this kit as https://github.com/stellar/go-stellar-sdk/issues/6043 against v0.9.0 and main 376279e8, covering mint and clawback, with stellar-etl named as the affected consumer.
